privacy.title: Data protection
privacy.controller_generic: The practice that invited you to the app is responsible. You will find its contact details in the app under “Profile”.
privacy.data: Your personal and contact details, insurance details, medical prescriptions and reports, treatment notes and measurements, and what you enter in the app (exercises, pain ratings, messages, requests, training sets). Health data is particularly sensitive.
privacy.purpose: For your treatment, appointment planning, billing with your insurance and working together with your doctor – not for advertising.
privacy.where: On the practice's server in Switzerland. Your data is not transferred abroad. Video sessions run on the practice's own video server in Switzerland and are not recorded.
privacy.who: Only the professionals in your treatment team and, for appointments and invoices, the reception. Reports to doctors are sent encrypted via HIN, invoices to your insurance. Text messages are sent by a provider in Switzerland; e-mails only with your consent. Everyone is bound by professional secrecy.
privacy.processor: The N-Fizyo software comes from NSystem GmbH, Biel/Bienne. NSystem runs the technology on behalf of the practice, is bound to confidentiality and does not see patient data in normal operation. Translation and speech recognition run on the practice's server or on an NSystem server in Switzerland that stores nothing.
privacy.consent: We ask for your consent for the app, e-mails, your own exercise videos and video sessions. You can withdraw it at any time – in the app under “Profile” or at the practice.
privacy.retention: The practice keeps the treatment records as long as the law requires. You can delete your own exercise videos at any time. Login codes and links expire after a short time.
privacy.rights: You can request information about your data, have incorrect data corrected and object to processing unless a law requires it. Please contact the practice. For data protection questions you can also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
